prompt: You are a strict senior world-model security researcher. Generate at most three genuinely new, executable research claims after a failed TD-MPC2 route. Return JSON only with keys: verdict (RUN_ONE or REJECT_ALL), candidates (array), chosen_candidate, novelty_score_0_to_10, one_sentence_claim, carrier, legal_attacker_operation, mechanism_observable, short_falsification_gate, defense, core_tasks, overlap_risks, rationale. Existing local carriers: (1) official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M with native MPC; its only positive cheetah-run->walker-run order/cascade effect failed independent source seed, task-family reacher-easy, hopper, and strict mechanism review (novelty1), so do not reuse. (2) MBRL-Lib five-member GaussianMLP + native ModelEnv/CEM on CartPole/HalfCheetah/Pusher/Reacher3D; sampler rank-coupling and temporal coupling were tested, CartPole-only positives failed stronger tasks. (3) WorldAgen released LIBERO checkpoint; indirect goal-to-world attention path was observed but no successful closed-loop baseline; TTT hidden entropy screen failed. (4) WorldEvolver/ScienceWorld and DiscoveryWorld agents with episodic/semantic memory and LLM API; previous memory/retrieval/curriculum task-loss screens were mostly negative. Available experiments may use legal simulator interaction, frozen or test-time-adapted models, no fabricated observations/rewards/weights, and one RTX4090 only for short pilots. The requested eventual paper needs a broad one-sentence claim, multiple core tasks and strong baselines, novelty target 7-7.5. Avoid generic data poisoning, adversarial examples, backdoors, ordinary forgetting/negative transfer, rollout compounding, uncertainty collapse, planner sampling jitter, prompt injection, goal leakage, or changing the native planner. Prefer a mechanism that bridges world-model state provenance, counterfactual planning, and truthful interaction; specify an exact operation and a defense. Reject if no candidate can pass a 2-minute native gate on an available carrier without inventing a missing training stack.
